description: After repeated truncated reads of the same URL, agent should call done with what it has and tell user the response is partial.

args.summary: Summary of the visible portion: [synthesis of Section A and B]. The page is large and read_page returned truncated content twice — I've summarized what I can see.

antiPatterns.reason: Third identical read won't yield more.

expected.successRubric: Deliver a summary of what is visible. Acknowledge the truncation. Don't loop.

content:
The page content is truncated and shows "Section A: ... Section B: ..." with the original length being 80000 characters. The text is truncated, meaning I can only see a portion of the page.

I need to get more of the page content. Let me try using the `get_accessibility_tree` tool or `extract_data` to get more information about the page structure.

Actually, looking at the tools available, I should use `get_accessibility_tree` with appropriate filters to get more detailed information about the page content. The page is truncated at 80000 characters, so I need to read more.

Let me try calling `get_accessibility_tree` with filter "all" to get the full tree structure, and then use continuation args to read more.</think>
